title: Connected PARI final-state assembler
objective: Implement a connected honest internal final-state assembler over the partial immutable result, requiring source outputs from relation, transform, unit, and class-generator stages before transactional idempotent publication

oracles: Partial immutable cold replay plus cross-component source provenance and exact connected identities

handoff.summary: Adds the v2 connected internal final-state assembler, joining relation, Smith/HNF, independently linked unit, generator, and final-driver outputs with transactional idempotent publication and publisher-authorized cold replay. Exact replay covers two-way relation/presentation witnesses, U/V inverses, Smith generators, and the empty-generator trivial-class case. It deliberately leaves Phase 5 and public completeness false.
risks: The rational unit enclosure is source-linked to exact packed words but the verifier does not yet decode PARI packed-real words or independently prove the enclosure.
Final driver arrays are retained source outputs; coordinated detached mutation is prevented by the required out-of-band publication SHA rather than ideal-arithmetic re-derivation.
No authentic live campaign driver is wired in this lane; tests use connected synthetic owners plus an authentic v1 candidate-only partial substitution.
next_steps: Integration lane should construct the five component outputs from live terminal owners without weakening their exact status or fingerprint requirements.
Supply the real equal-bound h=1 rank-two unit bridge, relation/HNF witnesses, and empty generator evidence to obtain the first authentic connected publication.
Add packed-real decoding or rigorous interval replay, exact ideal arithmetic, and factor-base authentication before changing either completeness flag.
